intro.title: Hi, I'm XC
intro.desc:
Undergraduate in Postal Engineering at Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications (Class of 2028, junior), focused on robot mechanical design, embedded hardware, and motion control.
Competition experience across RoboMaster, ROBOCON, and the Siemens Cup — from concept and assembly to system integration and on-site debugging.
Turning competition retrospectives and debugging notes into public engineering write-ups.
Email: 209358371@qq.com

project1.title: RoboMaster 2025 Shanghai · Infantry Robot
project1.desc:
Led the infantry robot's mechanical system design, including the omnidirectional chassis, Yaw/Pitch gimbal transmission, and overall structural layout, while coordinating interfaces with the electronics and algorithm teams.

Handled parts sourcing, external machining, and assembly delivery; completed full-robot assembly, structural inspection, and pre-event improvements.

Worked with the electronics and algorithm teams on chassis motion, gimbal transmission, and full-robot control integration; diagnosed and resolved structural interference, assembly fit, and mechanism-operation issues.

Technical focus
  • Omnidirectional chassis and Yaw/Pitch gimbal transmission design
  • Overall structural layout and mechanical/electronics/algorithm interface coordination
  • Assembly, structural inspection, and field issue closure

project2.title: ROBOCON 2026 · Bionic Legged Robot
project2.mediaAlt2: Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications ROBOCON 2026 team with the robot
project2.mediaCaption2: Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications ROBOCON 2026 Team
project2.desc:
Owned motor bring-up, low-level communication, motion-control algorithms, and full-robot integration, including interface validation between drivers, sensors, and the main controller.

For complex terrain and continuous tasks, iterated motor parameters and motion-control strategies to improve motion stability and task consistency.

Built a validation loop across module tests, full-robot integration, and field re-tests; diagnosed and closed communication, actuator, and strategy-parameter issues. Adapted the task flow to the competition rules.

Technical focus
  • Motor parameter tuning and low-level communication validation
  • Motion-control strategy iteration for complex terrain
  • Module testing, full-robot integration, and field re-test workflow

project3.title: Siemens Cup 2026 · Industrial Embedded System
project3.desc:
Led the hardware side of an industrial embedded system, breaking the task requirements into controllers, sensors, actuators, and communication interfaces.

Completed hardware schematics and board-level design in LCEDA, advancing component selection, signal chains, and debugging preparation around system functions and interface constraints.

Worked with the software team on system integration; diagnosed, modified, and re-tested hardware for on-site issues to support stable task execution.

Technical focus
  • Controller, sensor, actuator, and communication-interface decomposition
  • LCEDA schematic and PCB board-level design
  • Hardware diagnosis, modification, and system integration

project4.title: RoboMaster 2026 Jiangsu · 3V3 Combat Robot
project4.desc:
Contributed to the development and field integration of a 3V3 non-armored combat robot, advancing full-robot delivery through mechanism assembly, system adaptation, and on-site troubleshooting.

Worked with the team on pre-event testing, fault reproduction, and live debugging to support stable robot operation in combat conditions.

Technical focus
  • Mechanism assembly and system adaptation
  • Pre-event testing and fault reproduction
  • Live debugging and full-robot delivery
